about_the_game:
Welcome to Dry Hard: Laundry Simulator – your cozy ticket to running the most charming dry cleaning shop in town!

In a quiet, picturesque small town, the scent of fresh laundry drifts through the air. Here, your days are filled with the gentle hum of machines, the satisfying snap of pressed collars, and the smiling faces of customers who trust you with their treasured garments.

🧺 Wash, Dry, and Press to Perfection


Take on customer orders big and small – from delicate dresses to heavy coats – and treat each item with care. Operate your machines to wash, dry, and press clothes until they’re spotless and crisp.

👗 Serve Quirky Customers


Meet a colorful cast of locals, each with their own laundry habits and unique requests. Some are picky about their pleats, others just want their lucky sweater cleaned before game day.

⚙ Upgrade Your Laundromat


Start small and grow your business. Purchase new machines that clean faster, add efficiency upgrades, and create a layout that keeps your workflow smooth.

🪡 Master Minigames


When the stains get stubborn or the seams split, jump into quick and satisfying minigames:
• Mend ripped clothing
• Remove tricky stains
• Restore fabrics to their best condition

📦 Stay Organized


Keep track of every order, match the right clothes to the right customer, and make sure nothing gets lost in the shuffle. The better your service, the more your reputation will grow.

✨ Features


• Cozy small-town setting with relaxing vibes
• Washing, drying, pressing, and mending gameplay
• Colorful, quirky customers with fun personalities
• Machine upgrades for faster, better service
• Engaging cleaning and repair minigames
• A charming, wholesome experience perfect for unwinding

Whether you’re a stickler for spotless shirts or just love the satisfying rhythm of a well-run shop, Dry Hard: Laundry Simulator is your chance to press your way to perfection!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
